facts.business: Baazar Style Retail Limited operates as a fashion retailer targeting Gen Z and young millennials in Tier II, III, and IV towns across India, offering contemporary designs, superior quality, and value-driven offerings.

auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Key audit matters include accounting of Right of Use (ROU) Assets and Leases under Ind AS 116, and existence and valuation of Inventories under Ind AS 2.
